# Paul Esuga

> Software engineering student at Pan-Atlantic University working across software, AI and cybersecurity. This portfolio covers selected projects, experience, and the films, music and podcasts behind the work.

## Pages

- [Home](https://polite-shortbread-5563c6.netlify.app/): about, selected work, experience, archive and contact
- [Probabli](https://polite-shortbread-5563c6.netlify.app/work/probabli): gamified prediction-market demo for PAU students
- [Cybersecurity and VAPT](https://polite-shortbread-5563c6.netlify.app/work/cybersecurity-vapt): vulnerability assessment and penetration testing experience
- [AI chatbot](https://polite-shortbread-5563c6.netlify.app/work/ai-chatbot): retrieval-augmented chatbot proof of concept on Amazon Bedrock
- [SIBAS](https://polite-shortbread-5563c6.netlify.app/work/sibas): student and instructor attendance system with a PostgreSQL database
